div.div: لَظٌّ , (K,) or لَظٌّ كَظٌّ, (T, S, M,) A man hard, or difficult, in disposition; (S, K;) as also ↓ لَظْلَاظٌ : (Ibn-'Abbád, K:) or a man hard, o difficult, in disposition, (T, M;) and treated with severity, or rigour, (T,) or straitened; (M;) as also ↓ مِلَظٌّ and ↓ مِلْظَاظٌ : (M:) كظّ is app. an imitative sequent. (M.) You say, إِنَّهُ ↓ لَحَدِيدٌ لَظْلَاظٌ Verily he is [sharp and] evil (زَعِر) in disposition. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
